messages:
sam (sales): quick heads-up — Nebula POC is seeing repeated 429s mid-demo. They run long multi-turn sessions (6–8k tokens each) and we see the per-route quota flagging. can we swarm? @liam @anya :wave:

liam (eng): yes, can you paste a sample request id + timestamp from the logs? also which model variant?

sam (sales): copied two log lines from their repro run a few mins ago:
```
2026-03-21T15:02:12Z request_id=nb-01abc resp=200 tokens=6123 route=/api/v1/generate model=g-3.2x
2026-03-21T15:03:08Z request_id=nb-01abd resp=429 error=rate_limit_exceeded reason=per_route_token_quota scope=route/nebulapoc window=3600
```

anya (sre): thanks. that error text explicitly points at a per-route token budget (route/nebulapoc). not global account cap. Could be their traffic pattern exhausting the hourly token reservation. also check concurrent request bursts — if they send parallel chats it eats windowed budget faster.

matt (oncall): just pulled metrics for route/nebulapoc (last 30m): 95th latency normal, token consumption spike at 15:00 with ~9 simultaneous long sessions. quota-bot reported: "route/nebulapoc token_window=3600 budget=50000 used=51230" — so we crossed the configured reservation.

sam (sales): their engineering said they use client-side retries with exponential backoff but retries occur quickly, exacerbating the quota exhaustion. customer asked if we can temporarily raise anything — they're mid-demo tomorrow.

liam (eng): short-term options: 1) increase route token reservation for this customer for next 24h (temp uplift), 2) enable soft-throttle (429 with Retry-After) so client retries slower, 3) suggest client switch to streaming to reduce token overhead. Which do we want?

anya (sre): procedure: we can do a controlled bump — add +25k tokens to route reservation and monitor. I'll need an org ticket and approver. Also propose adding a per-tenant burst window to avoid full window drain from a small number of sessions.

sam (sales): customer ok with short-term bump. I'll get their demo window and permission. can you outline what I should tell them to change client-side to reduce chance of recurrence?

liam (eng): tell them: - merge multiple back-to-back calls into one request where possible - use streaming to avoid full-buffer encoding - enable KV prefix caching for repeated history retrieval - add jitter to retry logic (0.5–1.5s) and respect Retry-After header. Also consider reducing maximum allowed user turn length or summarizing earlier turns.

matt (oncall): operational note: I'm going to add a short-lived alert rule to flag route/nebulapoc usage > 90% of its reservation for the next 48h so we can act before full exhaustion.

anya (sre): I'll create the uplift change now and link the change-ticket here. Applying +25000 tokens to route/nebulapoc for 24h. rollback scheduled automatically after 24h unless flagged. Change ID: CHG-12571.

sam (sales): solid, thx. user-facing message I will send: "We’ve temporarily increased your route quota for the demo window and added safeguards so requests that exceed limits will receive Retry-After with jitter recommendations. For long-term stability we recommend KV caching, streaming, and a reserved dedicated plan if you expect sustained high token throughput."

liam (eng): follow-up for product: we should consider per-tenant token reservations with a small burst allowance separate from hourly windows — reduces manual bumps. filing idea in product backlog.

anya (sre): monitoring checklist: - confirm CHG-12571 applied - watch alerts for 10m contiguous >90% usage - capture 429 request_ids and backtrace to client pattern - hold immediate rollback if we see secondary failures.

sam (sales): action items: Sam -> confirm demo time with Nebula and get written ok for temp uplift. Anya -> apply change & post verification screenshot. Matt -> watch alerts. Liam -> draft client guidance snippet for me to paste into support email. I'll update customer in 10m. :thumbsup:

quota-bot: automated: route/nebulapoc reservation increased by +25000 (change: CHG-12571). Active until 2026-03-22T15:03:00Z.

sam (sales): update — Nebula confirmed demo at 2026-03-21T16:00Z and OK'd the uplift. I'll close the loop after demo. thanks everyone.
